answer: Faking thousands of identities means posting thousands of real bonds, so forgery costs scale linearly while honest returns stay positive. Sybil resistance comes from stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a verifiable deposit prior to acting, and peers attest only after work is validated. Think of a lantern marking a safe jetty: entry is visible but expensive. From that mesa of locked stake, reputation accrues only through delivered results, making mass impersonation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0173 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
